s: to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile
703502.lxx: in LXX: 1Ki.29:4 (רָצָה hithp.), I Est.4:31, al.
703502.full: δι-αλλάσσω [in LXX: 1Ki.29:4 (רָצָה hithp.), I Est.4:31, al. ;] __1. to change, exchange. __2. to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile: pass., with dative of person(s), Mat.5:24. "The word denotes mutual concession after mutual hostility, an idea absent from καταλλ-," which see (Lft., Notes, 288; cf. Deiss., LAE, 178.15; Cremer, 91, 632).† (AS)

703505.lxx: in LXX chiefly for חשׁב, frequently in Pss.
703505.full: δια-λογίζομαι, depon. [in LXX chiefly for חשׁב, frequently in Pss. ;] __1. to balance accounts (Dem.). __2. to consider, reason (Isocr.): Luk.1:29 5:21; ἐν τ. καρδία, Mrk.2:6, 8, Luk.5:22; περί Luk.3:15; ἐν ἑαυτῷ (-οῖς), Mat.16:7-8, Mrk.2:8, Luk.12:17; πρὸς ἑ., Mrk.9:33 11:31, Luk.20:14; παρ᾽ ἑ., Mat.21:25 (ἐν ἑ., T, WH, mg.); πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Mrk.8:16; ὅτι, Mrk.8:17, Jhn.11:50, Rec. (DB, i, 611; Cremer, 400).† (AS)

703506.full: δια-λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (διαλογίζομαι) [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲשָׁבָה ;] a thought, reasoning, inward questioning: Mat.15:19, Mrk.7:21, Luk.2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38, Rom.1:21 14:1, 1Co.3:20" (LXX), Php.2:14; κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. (cf. Pro.12:5), Jas.2:4; χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ δ. (where perh. δ., like מְזִמָּה, in Ps 138(139):20, al., implies evil intention), 1Ti.2:8 (see Hort, in l.; cf. Cremer, 400).† (AS)

703508.full: 1. a loosing one from another, separating, parting , τῆς ψυχῆς καὶ τοῦ σώματος (Plato Philosophus); δ. τοῦ σώματος its dissolution , (Plato Philosophus); ἡ δ. τῆς γεφύρας the breaking down the bridge, (Thucydides): the disbanding , of troops, Xen.; ἡ δ. τῆς ἀγορᾶς the time of its breaking up , Hdt.; τὴν δ. ἐποιήσαντο broke off the action, Thuc.; δ. γάμου a divorce , (Plutarch) 2. an ending, cessation , κακῶν Eur.; πολέμου (Thucydides): absolute a cessation of hostilities, peace , (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

703509.lxx: in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc.
703509.full: δια-λύω [in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc. ;] to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: Act.5:36.† (AS)

703510.full: 1. to go astray from , τῆς ὁδοῦ (Thucydides): to fail of obtaining , τινός (Thucydides) 2. absolute to fail utterly , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

703512.full: as attic law-term, evidence given to prevent a case from coming to trial, (Demosthenes Orator), etc. (ML)

703513.lxx: in LXX chiefly for עוּד hi., usually with dative of person(s), Deu.4:26 8:19, 1Ki.8:9, al.
703513.full: δια-μαρτύρομαι, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, which see, [in LXX chiefly for עוּד hi., usually with dative of person(s), Deu.4:26 8:19, 1Ki.8:9, al. ;] solemnly to protest: Luk.16:28, Act.2:40 8:25 10:42 18:5 20:21, 23, 24 23:11 28:23, 1Th.4:6, Heb.2:6; in adjuration, before ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1Ti.5:21, 2Ti.2:14 4:1 (Cremer, 415).† (AS)

703515.lxx: in LXX for לחם ni., Dan LXX 10:20; Sir.8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 *
703515.full: δια-μάχομαι [in LXX for לחם ni., Dan LXX 10:20; Sir.8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 * ;] __1. to struggle against. __2. In argument, to contend: Act.23:9.† (AS)

703517.full: δια-μένω [in LXX for עמד, etc.;] to remain, continue: Luk.1:22 22:28, Gal.2:5, Heb.1:11" (LXX), 2Pe.3:4.† (AS)

703518.lxx: in LXX chiefly for חלק pi.
703518.full: δια-μερίζω [in LXX chiefly for חלק pi. ;] __1. to distribute: with dative of person(s), Act.2:45; before εἰς, Luk.22:17, pass., Act.2:3. Mid. to distribute among themselves: Mat.27:35, Mrk.15:24, Luk.23:34; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, Jhn.19:24 (LXX) (see M, Pr., 157). __2. to divide, separate: pass., before ἐπί, with accusative, Luk.11:17-18; ἐπί, with dative, Luk.12:52-53.† (AS)

703519.full: δια-μερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (διαμερίζω), [in LXX: Eze.48:29 (מַחֲלֹקֶת), Mic.7:12 * ;] a division: opposite to εἰρήνη, Luk.12:51.† (AS)

s: to measure out in portions, distribute
to have measured out to one, receive as one's share
703520.full: 1. to measure through, out or off , χῶρον δ. to measure lists for combat, (Iliad by Homer):—;Pass., ἡμέρα διαμεμετρημένη measured by the clepsydra , (Demosthenes Orator) 2. to measure out in portions, distribute , (Xenophon Historicus), etc.:—;Mid. to have measured out to one, receive as one's share , (Oracle quoted in Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

703523.full: δια-νέμω [in LXX for חלק, Deu.29:25 * ;] to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, Act.4:17.† (AS)

s: to wink at, nod to, beckon to
703524.full: δια-νεύω [in LXX: Ps 34(35):19 (קרץ), Sir.27:22 * ;] to wink at, nod to, beckon to: Luk.1:22.† (AS)

703529.lxx: in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., Isa.55:9, al., frequently in Sir
703529.full: δια-νόημα, -τος, τό (διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., Isa.55:9, al., frequently in Sir ;] a thought: Luk.11:17.† (AS)

703531.lxx: in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב
703531.full: διάνοια, -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב ;] the understanding, mind: Luk.1:51, Eph.4:18, Col.1:21, 1Pe.1:13, 2Pe.3:1, 1Jn.5:20; pl., Eph.2:3; in quotations from LXX, Mat.22:37, Mrk.12:30, Luk.10:27, Heb.8:10 10:16 (Cremer, 79, 438).† (AS)

s: to open up completely, to open
703532.lxx: in LXX for פֶּטֶר (Ex, Nu), פָּקַח, פָּתַח, etc.
703532.full: δι-αν-οίγω [in LXX for פֶּטֶר (Ex, Nu), פָּקַח, פָּתַח, etc. ;] to open up completely, to open: Luk.2:23 (LXX); pass., Mrk.7:34, Act.7:56. Metaphorical, δ. τ. νοῦν, Luk.24:45, τ. καρδίαν, Act.16:14, pass., οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, Luk.24:31; of explaining, τ. γραφάς, Luk.24:32, Act.17:3.† (AS)

703533.full: δια-νυκτερεύω (cf. διημερεύω, to pass the day) [in LXX: Job.2:9 * ;] to pass the night: before ἐν τ. προσευχῆ, Luk.6:12.† (AS)

703534.full: δι-ανύω [in LXX: 2Ma.12:17 * ;] __1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: Act.21:7 (EV). __2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).† (AS)

703538.full: to make to cease :—; Mid. to rest between times, pause , (Plato Philosophus):—;Pass. to cease to exist , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

703539.full: to threaten violently , (Herdotus Historicus):—;so in Mid., (Aeschines Orator) (ML)

703542.full: 1. to send off in different directions, send to and fro, send about or round , (Herdotus Historicus) 2. to send over or across , (Aristophanes Comicus): to transmit , ἐπιστολήν (Thucydides); so in Mid., (Thucydides) (ML)

703543.full: δια-περάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Deu.30:13, Isa.23:2 (עבר), עבר), 1Ma.6:1-63 * ;] to pass over, cross over: Mat.9:1; before ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Mat.14:34, Mrk.6:53; εἰς, Mrk.5:21, Act.21:2; πρὸς ἡμᾶς, Luk.16:28.† (AS)

s: to fall asunder, crumble in pieces
to fail utterly, go quite wrong
703546.full: 1. to fall away, slip away, escape , (Xenophon Historicus) 2. of reports and rumours, to spread abroad , (Xenophon Historicus) 3. to fall asunder, crumble in pieces , (Plato Philosophus) 4. to fail utterly, go quite wrong , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

703548.full: Dep. to spar with, skirmish with , τινι (Plutarch) (ML)

s: to breathe between times, get breath
703549.full: 1. to blow through : —; Pass., αὔραις διαπνεῖσθαι (Xenophon Historicus) 2. to breathe between times, get breath , (Plutarch) 3. intransitive to disperse in vapour , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

s: to be worn out, sore troubled
703550.lxx: in LXX: Ecc.10:9 (עָצַב ni.), 2Ma.2:28; in Aq.: Gen.6:6, 1Ki.20:3 *
703550.full: δια-πονέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Ecc.10:9 (עָצַב ni.), 2Ma.2:28; in Aq.: Gen.6:6, 1Ki.20:3 * ;] to work out with labour. Pass., to be worn out, sore troubled: Mrk.14:4 (WH, mg.), Act.4:2 16:18.† (AS)

703562.lxx: in LXX for בָּזַז, גָּזַל, שָׁסַס, etc.
703562.full: δι-αρπάζω [in LXX for בָּזַז, גָּזַל, שָׁסַס, etc. ;] to plunder: Mat.12:29, Mrk.3:27.† (AS)

703565.full: δια-ρήσσω (so WH, exc. Ac, l.with), δια-ρρήσσω (poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] to break asunder, burst, rend: δεσμά, Luk.8:29; pass., δίκτυα, Luk.5:6; ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger (as Gen.37:29, al.), Mat.26:65, Act.14:14, Mrk.14:63.† (AS)

703567.full: 1. to cast or shoot through , (Odyssey by Homer) 2. to cast or throw about , a dog, to wag the tail, (Xenophon Historicus) 3. to throw about , as nuts or money among a crowd, (Aristophanes Comicus) 4. intransitive to plunge , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

703571.full: to shake violently: to reduce to anarchy , Luc.; διασεσαλευμένος unsteady , (Lucian) (ML)

703572.lxx: in LXX: Deu.1:5 (בָּאַר pi.), Dan LXX 2:6 (חָוָה aphel.), I-III Ma 9 *
703572.full: δια-σαφέω, -ῶ (σαφής, clear), [in LXX: Deu.1:5 (בָּאַר pi.), Dan LXX 2:6 (חָוָה aphel.), I-III Ma 9 * ;] to make clear, explain fully: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Mat.13:26 18:31.† (AS)

703574.full: δια-σείω [in LXX: Job.4:14 (פָּחַד hi.), 3Ma.7:21 * ;] to shake violently; metaphorically, to intimidate: Luk.3:14.† (AS)

703576.full: 1. to get quite ready, equip , (Lucian):—;Pass., perfect participle διεσκευασμένοι dressed , (Plutarch): —;Mid. to prepare for oneself, provide , (Thucydides): to equip oneself , (Xenophon Historicus) 2. Mid., διασκευασάμενος τὴν οὐσίαν having disposed of one's property, (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

703579.lxx: in LXX for פּוּץ, זָרָה, etc.
703579.full: δια-σκορπίζω [in LXX for פּוּץ, זָרָה, etc. ;] to scatter abroad, disperse: of sheep, Mat.26:31 = Mrk.14:27" (LXX) ; of persons, Luk.1:51, Act.5:37, opposite to συνάγω, Jhn.11:52; of winnowing grain, Mat.25:24, 26; metaphorically, of property, to squander, waste: Luk.15:13 16:1.† (AS)

703583.lxx: in LXX chiefly for נָתַק, as Jdg.16:9
703583.full: δια-σπάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for נָתַק, as Jdg.16:9 ;] to break or tear asunder: pass., ἁλύσεις, Mrk.5:4; Παῦλος, Act.23:10.† (AS)

703584.full: δια-σπείρω [frequently in LXX for פּוּץ, etc. ;] to scatter abroad, disperse: Act.8:1, 4 11:19.† (AS)

703585.lxx: in LXX of Israelites dispersed and exiled in foreign lands, as Deu.28:25 (זַעֲוָה) Deu.30:4 (נָדַח ni.), Isa.49:6 (נער); by meton., of the exiles themselves (as Psa.147:2, 2Ma.1:27)
703585.full: δια-σπορά, -ᾶς, ἡ (διασπείρω), [in LXX of Israelites dispersed and exiled in foreign lands, as Deu.28:25 (זַעֲוָה) Deu.30:4 (נָדַח ni.), Isa.49:6 (נער); by meton., of the exiles themselves (as Psa.147:2, 2Ma.1:27) ;] a dispersion: δ. τῶν Ἑλλήνων, Jhn.7:35; metaphorically, of Christians (DB, iii, 782 f.), Jas.1:1, 1Pe.1:1 (see Hort, in ll).† (AS)

703588.lxx: in LXX for בָּדַל hi. (Deu.10:8, al.), זְהַר hi. (Eze.3:18-19, al.), and 19 other words
703588.full: δια-στελλω [in LXX for בָּדַל hi. (Deu.10:8, al.), זְהַר hi. (Eze.3:18-19, al.), and 19 other words] __1. to divide, distinguish, define. __2. to command, charge expressly: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, Heb.12:20. Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.with; and al. in LXX; MM, see word); a. dative of person(s), Mrk.8:15, Act.15:24; before ἵνα, Mat.16:20, Mrk.5:43 7:36 9:9.† (AS)

703589.full: διάστημα, -τος, τό (διίστημι), [in LXX for רֶוַח, etc. ;] an interval, space: of time (Sir, prol. 24), Act.5:7.† (AS)

703590.lxx: in LXX for פְּדוּת: Exo.8:23, etc.
703590.full: δια-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (διαστέλλω), [in LXX for פְּדוּת: Exo.8:23, etc. ;] __1. a separation. __2. a distinction, difference: Rom.3:22 10:12, 1Co.14:7.† (AS)

703592.lxx: in LXX for הָפַךְ, עָקַשׁ, etc.
703592.full: δια-στρέφω [in LXX for הָפַךְ, עָקַשׁ, etc. ;] to distort, twist; metaphorically, to distort, pervert: Luk.23:2, Act.13:8, 10; διεστραμμένος, perverse: Mat.17:17, Luk.9:41, Act.20:30, Php.2:15.† (AS)

703598.full: to cleave or rend asunder , (Odyssey by Homer), etc.:—;Pass. to be cloven asunder , (Iliad by Homer); of soldiers, to be separated , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

s: to bring safely through a danger
703599.lxx: in LXX for מָלַט, יָשַׁע, etc.
703599.full: δια-σώζω [in LXX for מָלַט, יָשַׁע, etc. ;] to bring safely through a danger: Luk.7:3, Act.27:43; before πρός, Act.23:24. Pass., to come safe through: Act.28:1; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Act.27:44; ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, Act.28:4; δι᾽ ὕδατος, 1Pe.3:20; of sickness, to recover: Mat.14:36.† (AS)
